review-pr.md: So post your verdict to GitHub during the turn, before the reply that
- Read the diff: `gh pr diff task/00-sample-card` (or by PR number), or `git diff`
should run read-only commands (gh, git log, grep).

When you have a verdict, POST it to GitHub:
- approve:          gh pr review task/00-sample-card --approve --body "<your summary>"
- request changes:  gh pr review task/00-sample-card --request-changes --body "<your findings>"
